pricing.priceLists.title: Price lists
pricing.priceLists.intro: Special prices by list. A fixed-price list sets a price per product and quantity; a discount list applies a percentage to the base price.
pricing.priceLists.column.name: Name
pricing.priceLists.field.name: Name
pricing.priceLists.hint.percent: Between 0 and 100, with up to 2 decimals. For example, 10.00 for a 10 % discount.
pricing.priceLists.hint.validity: Leave the date empty if it has no limit.
